card.name: Digits inside statistical results
card.fires_on: A digit or decimal point partway through a number in a reported statistic, such as the end of a confidence interval, a percentage or a count, just before the number ends.

modes.label: Confidence interval upper bound
modes.description: A digit inside the upper limit of a 95% CI after a hazard or risk ratio.

modes.label: Percentages and counts
modes.description: A digit in a rate or event count within a results table or sentence.
modes.example: attack solved 17,338 out of 17,495 challenges they attempted, a success rate of 99.<<1>> percent.
